blocks.text: 以下是 Google AI Studio 今天为 Android 应用开发推出的新功能：

inlines.text: 以下是 Google AI Studio 今天为 Android 应用开发推出的新功能：
全栈持久化与登录：
自动配置带安全规则的 Cloud Firestore 数据库和 Google 登录，让用户数据在会话和设备之间同步。
安全的 Gemini API 调用：
在 Android 应用中调用 Gemini 模型，无需在 APK 中暴露 API 密钥，由 Firebase AI Logic 和
Firebase App Check
提供保护。
发布到个人 Google Play：
用普通 Google 账号把 Android 应用直接发布到个人 Google Play 库，点几下就能装到手机上。
更快、带音频的高清模拟器：
启动延迟更低的 Android 模拟器，可开关高清视频流，并直接在浏览器中测试实时音频输出。
一键截图发给智能体：
单击即可截取运行中模拟器的实时画面，并附加到提示词中，指导界面视觉修改。
自定义字体与 Android CLI 集成：
用自定义字体为 Jetpack Compose 界面设置样式，底层由官方 Android CLI 支撑，确保项目脚手架和构建可靠。

blocks.text: 借助 Cloud Firestore、Authentication 和 Firebase AI Logic，几分钟搞定全栈

inlines.text: 借助 Cloud Firestore、Authentication 和 Firebase AI Logic，几分钟搞定全栈

blocks.text: 此前，在 AI Studio 中生成的 Android 应用只能使用本地会话存储。现在，当你的提示词描述的 Android 应用需要持久化存储、用户登录或生成式 AI 功能时，Google AI Studio Build 智能体会主动识别这些需求。经你确认后，智能体会自动配置后端并接好你的 Kotlin 代码库：

inlines.text: 此前，在 AI Studio 中生成的 Android 应用只能使用本地会话存储。现在，当你的提示词描述的 Android 应用需要持久化存储、用户登录或生成式 AI 功能时，Google AI Studio Build 智能体会主动识别这些需求。经你确认后，智能体会自动配置后端并接好你的 Kotlin 代码库：
用 Cloud Firestore 实现跨设备持久化数据：
Build 智能体会配置
Cloud Firestore
数据库、设置 Firebase Android SDK，并针对你的数据模型生成定制的 Firebase 安全规则。用户可以在 Android 平板上开始会话，然后在手机上接着上次的进度继续，离线缓存会在网络恢复后自动同步。
用 Firebase Authentication 管理身份：
当应用需要用户资料或私有工作区时，智能体会配置带 Google 登录的
Firebase Authentication
，并搭配按用户划分的授权规则，让用户只能读写自己的文档。
借助 Firebase AI Logic 保护服务端凭据：
把 API 密钥硬编码在客户端 APK 里，有被提取的风险。当你的 Android 应用调用 Gemini 模型时，Build 智能体会自动配置
Firebase AI Logic
，并通过 Google Fraud Defense（原 reCAPTCHA Enterprise）启用
Firebase App Check
。凭据始终在服务端受到保护，App Check 则会验证每个传入请求都来自你未经篡改的正版应用——无论是在浏览器模拟器中还是在 Google Play 上。

blocks.text: 打造出色的移动端界面，离不开紧密的视觉与交互反馈闭环。浏览器内的 Android 模拟器和 Build 智能体的工具链都新增了能力，帮你实时检查、聆听并打磨应用：

inlines.text: 打造出色的移动端界面，离不开紧密的视觉与交互反馈闭环。浏览器内的 Android 模拟器和 Build 智能体的工具链都新增了能力，帮你实时检查、聆听并打磨应用：
更快的启动与 1200p 高清串流：
模拟器现在的启动延迟大幅降低，让你能快速测试代码改动。使用模拟器工具栏中的
高清开关
即可将画面切换为 1200p 高清，便于检查 Jetpack Compose 中细微的间距、动画和密集布局。
实时音频输出：
直接在浏览器中收听 Android 模拟器的实时音频。无需离开 Google AI Studio，就能构建和测试语音驱动的 Gemini Live API 伙伴、文本转语音（TTS）教练、带音效的游戏和媒体应用。
一键截图发给智能体：
用文字描述界面视觉问题可能要写上一大段。点击模拟器工具栏中的
截图
，即可截取应用实时画面并直接附到提示词里。指出你想做的调整——比如收紧卡片内边距、修正对比度或重新对齐工具栏——Gemini 就能结合完整的视觉上下文更新 Kotlin UI 代码。
支持自定义字体：
向智能体提出使用自定义字体，为应用打造独特的视觉风格。Build 智能体会自动下载、配置你选定的字体，并将其应用到整个 Compose 主题。
底层由 Android CLI 驱动：
在幕后，Google AI Studio 的 Build 智能体现在使用官方
Android CLI
来搭建项目结构、查询最新的 Android 文档并执行 Gradle 构建，从而减少构建错误，并支持更复杂的多屏架构。

inlines.text: Here is what is launching today for Android app development in Google AI Studio:
Full-stack persistence and sign-in:
Automatically provision a Cloud Firestore database with Security Rules and Google Sign-In so user data syncs across sessions and devices.
Secure Gemini API calls:
Call Gemini models from your Android app without exposing API keys in your APK, protected by Firebase AI Logic and
Firebase App Check
Personal Google Play publishing:
Ship Android apps directly to your personal Google Play library with a standard Google account and install them on your phone in clicks.
Faster, high-definition emulator with audio:
Spin up Android emulators with lower latency, toggle HD video streaming, and test real-time audio output directly in your browser.
One-click screenshot to agent:
Capture a live frame from the running emulator with a single click and attach it to your prompt to guide visual UI edits.
Custom fonts and Android CLI integration:
Style Jetpack Compose UIs with custom typography, backed under the hood by the official Android CLI for reliable project scaffolding and builds.

blocks.text: Previously, Android apps generated in AI Studio were limited to local session storage. Now, when your prompt describes an Android app that needs persistent storage, user sign-in, or generative AI features, the Google AI Studio Build agent proactively detects those requirements. With your confirmation, the agent provisions the backend and wires up your Kotlin codebase automatically:

inlines.text: Previously, Android apps generated in AI Studio were limited to local session storage. Now, when your prompt describes an Android app that needs persistent storage, user sign-in, or generative AI features, the Google AI Studio Build agent proactively detects those requirements. With your confirmation, the agent provisions the backend and wires up your Kotlin codebase automatically:
Persistent, cross-device data with Cloud Firestore:
The Build agent provisions a
Cloud Firestore

database, configures the Firebase Android SDKs, and generates Firebase Security Rules tailored to your data model. Users can start a session on an Android tablet and pick up right where they left off on their phone, with offline caching that syncs automatically when connectivity returns.
Identity management with Firebase Authentication:
When your app needs user profiles or private workspaces, the agent configures
Firebase Authentication
with Google Sign-In and pairs it with per-user authorization rules so users can only read and write their own documents.
Server-side credential protection with Firebase AI Logic:
Hardcoding API keys inside a client APK risks credential extraction. When your Android app calls Gemini models, the Build agent automatically configures
Firebase AI Logic
and enforces
Firebase App Check

using Google Fraud Defense (formerly reCAPTCHA Enterprise). Credentials stay protected server-side, and App Check verifies that incoming requests originate from your authentic, untampered app—both in the browser emulator and on Google Play.

blocks.text: Building great mobile interfaces requires a tight visual and interactive feedback loop. Both the in-browser Android emulator and the Build agent's toolchain include new capabilities to help you inspect, hear, and refine your app in real time:

inlines.text: Building great mobile interfaces requires a tight visual and interactive feedback loop. Both the in-browser Android emulator and the Build agent's toolchain include new capabilities to help you inspect, hear, and refine your app in real time:
Faster startup and 1200p HD streaming:
Emulators now boot with significantly lower latency so you can test code changes rapidly. Use the
HD toggle
in the emulator toolbar to switch the stream to 1200p high definition, making it easy to inspect fine Jetpack Compose spacing, animations, and dense layouts.
Real-time audio output:

Hear live audio from the Android emulator directly in your browser. You can build and test voice-driven Gemini Live API companions, text-to-speech (TTS) coaches, sound-enabled games, and media apps without leaving Google AI Studio.
One-click screenshot to agent:
Describing a visual layout issue in text can take paragraphs. Click
Take a screenshot

in the emulator toolbar to capture the live app screen and attach it directly to your prompt. Point out the adjustment you want—such as tightening card padding, fixing contrast, or realigning a toolbar—and Gemini updates the Kotlin UI code with full visual context.
Custom fonts support:
Give your app a distinct visual identity by asking the agent for custom fonts. The Build agent automatically downloads, configures, and applies your chosen typography across your Compose theme.
Powered by the Android CLI under the hood:
Behind the scenes, the Google AI Studio Build agent now uses the official
Android CLI
to scaffold project structures, query current Android documentation, and execute Gradle builds, reducing build errors and supporting more complex multi-screen architectures.
